subject.title: fix(matrix): reverse-proxy path support for Matrix homeserver URLs

question: Should a Matrix `homeserver` value containing a non-root path be treated as the API base path for all non-absolute Matrix endpoints?
rationale: The supplied proof and regression tests support this behavior, but it changes compatibility-sensitive channel routing semantics for existing path-valued settings and should be explicitly accepted by the Matrix area owner.

options.title: Confirm base-path semantics and land
options.body: Treat the configured homeserver URL as the complete API base, refresh the branch against main, and merge after the relevant checks pass.

options.title: Keep origin-root semantics
options.body: Reject the path-preserving behavior if Matrix configuration is intentionally defined as origin-only, then close or replace this PR with that documented contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm base-path semantics and land
recommendation.body: Treat the configured homeserver URL as the complete API base, refresh the branch against main, and merge after the relevant checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person directly to the current reverse-proxy transport fix and branch refresh.
